Meanwhile, the domestic energy sector faces an uphill battle to restore public trust following earthquake data manipulation scandals.

articles.title: Seino Holdings works with rivals for better, cleaner transportation
articles.summary: In Japan’s logistics industry, companies have maintained independent delivery networks, with trucks from multiple companies operating in the same areas. In addition, due to smaller shipments and underused return trips, the “loading efficiency” of freight vehicles has remained at around 40% of what they could carry for the past 15 years or so. This is not only inefficient, but also hinders efforts to reduce carbon dioxide emissions in the industry.

articles.title: Japanese bonds rally across curve as domestic stocks surge

articles.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
